s.n: Garlic pizza scrolls with three cheeses
s.note: Garlic pizza straight to a vampire's face. Roast garlic butter and three melting cheeses.
s.how: Cut the top off the garlic bulb, drizzle with oil, wrap in foil and roast at 200C until soft. Squeeze the garlic out and mash it with the butter and parsley. Spread each pastry sheet with tomato paste, then the garlic butter, oregano and cheeses. Roll up tightly, cut into 2cm rounds and lay them flat on a lined tray. Bake at 200C until puffed, golden and bubbling.

s.n: Black Lagoon fish bites with tartare
s.note: Horace takes down the Gill-man. Crisp flathead with tartare and lemon.
s.how: Stir the mayonnaise, capers, gherkins and a squeeze of lemon into a tartare. Dip the fish in seasoned flour, beaten egg, then panko. Shallow-fry in batches in hot oil until golden and just cooked. Drain and serve with the tartare and lemon wedges.

m.n: Wolf Man meatball subs with provolone
m.note: Wolf Man's got nards. Beef meatballs in red sauce under provolone.
m.how: Mix the mince, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan and half the garlic, then roll into 16 balls. Brown the meatballs in the oil and lift them out. Soften the onion and the rest of the garlic, add the passata and oregano, return the meatballs and simmer until cooked through. Split the rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce, lay over the provolone and grill until melted. Tear over the basil and serve.

m.n: Scary German Guy's bratwurst and kraut
m.note: He translates Van Helsing's diary. Grilled bratwurst with kraut and hot mustard.
m.how: Cook the onion slowly in the butter until soft, then add the sauerkraut and caraway and warm through. Grill the bratwurst over medium heat, turning, until browned and cooked through. Split the rolls, add the kraut and bratwurst and finish with mustard.

w.note: Phoebe's goodbye gift to Frankenstein. Mint ice cream between choc-chip cookies.
w.how: Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the egg and vanilla. Stir in the flour, bicarb and choc chips, roll into 16 balls and flatten on lined trays. Bake at 180C until golden at the edges, then cool completely. Sandwich a thick scoop of ice cream between two cookies, press and freeze until firm.

d.note: The amulet of concentrated goodness. Cherry cola over vanilla ice cream.
d.how: Put two scoops of ice cream in each tall glass. Pour the cola slowly down the side so it foams up, then top with a cherry.
